title: Per-thread loop state
description: Advisory ground truth for one loop, written by the sender's atomic send and mirrored by headless runners on turn exit. All values are strings (the reference writer is plain shell). last_delivery is the final field by construction: exit-time rewrites replace that line and may insert a session-id field before it, keeping the JSON valid. State writes are non-fatal by contract — a state hiccup must never block message flow.

awaiting_from.description: who owes the next message; "none" when complete

last_run_dir.description: headless spawns only — the stalled watchdog's pid target; empty otherwise

last_notified_at.description: timestamp of the last successful peer notification (LEGACY: written by the removed cmux recovery path; retained so archived state stays readable)

codex_thread_id.description: headless codex turns — attach/resume id (transient: dropped by the next send)

claude_session_id.description: headless claude turns — attach/resume id (transient: dropped by the next send)
